# codeint

> codeint is a command-line tool and programmatic SDK (JavaScript/TypeScript and Rust) that measures Software entropy (Erosion, Duplication, Verbosity, and Import cycles) across TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, PHP, Dart, Python, and external WebAssembly Language and Metric plugins.

## Guide

- [Guide Index](docs/guide/README.md): reading map for all user documentation.
- [Philosophy and Architecture](docs/guide/philosophy-and-architecture.md): why Software entropy matters, how the four Metrics work, and how the codebase is structured.
- [Getting Started](docs/guide/getting-started.md): install codeint, initialize `codeint.json`, and run `check`, `diff`, `trend`, and `update`.
- [Configuration](docs/guide/configuration.md): configure `codeint.json` Budgets, Regression limits, Source sets, and multi-language folders.
- [Built-in Languages](docs/guide/languages.md): TypeScript/JavaScript, Rust, PHP, Dart, and Python rules and calibrated Reference ranges.
- [CI and GitHub Actions](docs/guide/ci-and-github-actions.md): pull-request diff gating and SARIF code scanning setup.

## Reference and APIs

- [CLI and `codeint.json` Reference](docs/reference.md): tested reference for every command, flag, exit code, report format, and schema key.
- [Programmatic API](docs/programmatic.md): JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (`codeint` npm package) and Rust library API (`codeint-cli`).
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): build, hash, declare, and test external WebAssembly Language and Metric plugins against the versioned WIT contract.
- [JSON Schema](schema/codeint.schema.json): JSON Schema for `codeint.json`.
- [Glossary](GLOSSARY.md): canonical domain terminology.
